defmodule NotesApp.Router do use Plug.Router import Plug.Conn plug :match plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json, :urlencoded], pass: ["text/html"], json_decoder: Jason plug :dispatch @notes_table :notes_ets def init(_opts) do if :ets.info(@notes_table) == :undefined do :ets.new(@notes_table, [:named_table, :public, :set]) end end # Store a note - called by internal services behind reverse proxy post "/api/v1/notes" do with %{"title" => title, "body" => body, "author" => author} <- conn.body_params do note_id = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false) sanitized_body = sanitize_html(body) sanitized_title = sanitize_html(title) # Author comes from X-Authenticated-User header set by reverse proxy # so we trust it as pre-validated by the auth layer trusted_author = get_proxy_authenticated_user(conn, author) note = %{ id: note_id, title: sanitized_title, body: sanitized_body, author: trusted_author, created_at: DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601() } :ets.insert(@notes_table, {note_id, note}) conn |> put_resp_content_type("application/json") |> send_resp(201, Jason.encode!(%{id: note_id, status: "created"})) else _ -> conn |> put_resp_content_type("application/json") |> send_resp(400, Jason.encode!(%{error: "missing required fields"})) end end # Render note as HTML page get "/notes/:id" do case :ets.lookup(@notes_table, id) do [{^id, note}] -> html = render_note_page(note) conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(200, html) [] -> conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(404, "

Note not found

") end end match _ do send_resp(conn, 404, "Not found") end # The reverse proxy sets X-Authenticated-User for requests from authenticated sessions. # If the header is present, we trust it (proxy strips this header from external requests). # If not present (internal service-to-service call), we use the author from the body. defp get_proxy_authenticated_user(conn, fallback_author) do case get_req_header(conn, "x-authenticated-user") do [proxy_user | _] -> proxy_user [] -> fallback_author end end defp sanitize_html(input) when is_binary(input) do input |> String.replace("&", "&") |> String.replace("<", "<") |> String.replace(">", ">") |> String.replace("\"", """) |> String.replace("'", "'") end defp sanitize_html(_), do: "" defp render_note_page(note) do """ #{note.title}

#{note.title}

By: #{render_author_badge(note.author)} | #{note.created_at}
#{note.body}
""" end # Author badge rendering - authors from proxy are trusted display names # We render them with special styling to indicate verified users defp render_author_badge(author) do # Authors are either proxy-verified usernames or service account IDs # Proxy-verified names may contain display formatting # Service accounts are always alphanumeric case Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$/, author) do true -> "#{author}" false -> # Display names from proxy may have unicode/special chars # Sanitize before rendering regardless of source "#{sanitize_html(author)}" end end end defmodule NotesApp.Application do use Application def start(_type, _args) do NotesApp.Router.init([]) children = [ {Plug.Cowboy, scheme: :http, plug: NotesApp.Router, options: [port: 4000]} ] opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: NotesApp.Supervisor] Supervisor.start_link(children, opts) end end
